target: Define and implement the DCP trusted input-provenance contract so serialized or caller-supplied data cannot confer execution eligibility across RoutingClassificationInput construction, RouteDecision.from_dict deserialization, and recommend_backend_cmd ingestion; only trusted in-process adapters may mint attested classifier input, and untrusted mutating input or deserialized RouteDecision data is capped at non-runnable.
invariants: No value present in serialized or caller-supplied input can confer execution eligibility for mutating scope.
Raw, from-dict, hand-constructed, and CLI JSON input remains untrusted by default.
Untrusted mutating input must not produce a runnable RouteDecision.

Caller-supplied RouteDecision JSON deserialized via RouteDecision.from_dict must not confer execution eligibility; serialized status=ALLOWED, red_lane_state=CLEAR, and authority_class=OPERATOR cannot make is_runnable() true without trusted provenance.
recommend_backend_cmd and any future executor consuming RouteDecision.is_runnable() must treat from_dict output as untrusted unless minted by a trusted in-process path.
Trusted adapters derive provenance from authoritative signals and never accept caller assertions that raise trust.
The runtime gate in this checkout is RouteDecision.is_runnable(); do not target a non-existent LaneDecision.is_executable API.
Classifier logic remains deterministic and pure; no connector, runner, live-write, MCP, network, shell, or dopetask execution is introduced.
DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0005 remains advisory design context only until present on main; it is not a blocking depends_on entry for this packet.

pr.title: feat(dcp): add trusted input provenance contract
pr.body: Implements DMX-DCP-MODEL-ROUTING-MVP-0007. Serialized/caller-supplied input cannot confer execution eligibility across RoutingClassificationInput construction, RouteDecision.from_dict deserialization, and recommend_backend_cmd ingestion; raw CLI/from-dict input remains untrusted, trusted adapters mint attested input by construction, and untrusted mutating or deserialized RouteDecision data is capped at non-runnable output. No execution, connector, runner, MCP, or live-write surface is added.

steps.task: Inspect classifier input construction, CLI deserialization, existing runnable decision API, and downstream DCP consumers before changing code.
requirements: Confirm the active execution/runnability gate is RouteDecision.is_runnable().
Confirm no LaneDecision.is_executable API exists in the current checkout before referring to execution gating.
Confirm _input_from_dict builds RoutingClassificationInput from arbitrary JSON and is therefore untrusted.
Confirm RouteDecision.from_dict accepts caller-supplied JSON and can currently yield is_runnable() true without trusted provenance.
Confirm recommend_backend_cmd deserializes RouteDecision via from_dict and is an existing ingestion path for serialized decisions.
validation: Inspection notes identify the existing runtime API and trust boundary before implementation.

steps.task: Add a minimal unforgeable attested-input capability and explicit untrusted path without allowing serialized input to raise trust.
requirements: Add input_adapters.py or equivalent only if it keeps trust construction small and auditable.
Raw JSON, from_dict, and hand-constructed RoutingClassificationInput must remain untrusted.
A trusted constructor such as from_authenticated_operator must derive provenance from arguments representing authoritative signals rather than accepting trust-raising caller overrides.
Any serialized attempt to self-assert attestation or trusted provenance must be ignored or rejected.
Untrusted mutating input must cap the RouteDecision to non-runnable while read-only classification remains unchanged.
validation: Raw mutating input is not runnable.
Raw read-only input classifies as before.
Serialized trust/attestation fields cannot make a mutating decision runnable.
Trusted adapter output can be runnable only when authoritative signals are safe.
Trusted adapter output remains non-runnable when 0006 risky provenance signals are derived.

steps.task: Harden RouteDecision deserialization and serialized decision ingestion so caller-supplied JSON cannot confer execution eligibility.
requirements: RouteDecision.from_dict must treat deserialized input as untrusted and must not allow serialized status, red_lane_state, or authority_class values alone to make is_runnable() true for mutating scope.
recommend_backend_cmd must consume only non-runnable RouteDecision output when the decision was deserialized from caller JSON rather than minted by a trusted in-process path.
Any future executor using RouteDecision.is_runnable() must inherit the same untrusted-from_dict cap.
Read-only inspection of deserialized decisions remains permitted; only execution eligibility is capped.
validation: Forged RouteDecision JSON with status=ALLOWED, red_lane_state=CLEAR, and authority_class=OPERATOR is not runnable after from_dict.
recommend_backend_cmd on untrusted deserialized RouteDecision does not treat the decision as execution-eligible.
Trusted in-process RouteDecision minting remains runnable only when authoritative signals are safe.
